platform: CJSR FM 88.5 Digital and Physical Album/EP Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CJSR accepts digital albums and EPs at music@cjsr.com and authorized physical media at its published Music Department address. Singles are rejected. A human must confirm that the selected release is not wholly AI-generated, prepare downloadable files rather than streaming-only or expiring links, add tagged MP3 metadata, track lengths, focus tracks, origin, a one-sheet and language warnings, and send manually. Keep the optional CAD 200 local advertising package separate from editorial submission. Stop if any CAPTCHA, login, mandatory payment or new restriction appears.

platform: Stereofox SubmitHub or Groover Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Stereofox explicitly accepts music only through its linked SubmitHub page or stated Groover route and does not process email or Discord submissions. A human must sign in to the external platform, inspect current fields, consent, privacy, CAPTCHA, targeting and free-versus-paid credit options, select a suitable MarcsMusic release and submit manually. Do not use the general contact form, email or Discord as workarounds, and stop before any payment unless separately approved.
